description: Fetch a comprehensive intelligence dossier for a patent by publication number. Returns bibliographic data (title, assignees, inventors, dates, legal status), independent claims, backward + forward citations, patent family, CPC classifications, examiner info, and similar documents. Costs 3 credits on a fresh fetch; subsequent calls within 24 hours read from cache and are free. The headline tool — most patent-analysis workflows start here.

patentNumber.description: Publication number in canonical form (e.g. US10867416B2, EP3500001B1). Accepts loose input like '10,867,416' or 'us10867416' — the server normalizes.

name: dossier

cached.description: Whether the result was served from the 24h cache (free).

header.description: Bibliographic data: title, assignees, inventors, dates, legal status.
